info.name: ålrium - QuizWiz API
info.description: ålrium - QuizWiz API (FastAPI). Questions are JSONB {"question","options":{"A".."D"},"answer"} where answer is the actual option text; several versions may share a date and the newest is served; questions are insert-only. Core operations: GET /api/v1/questions/today, GET /api/v1/admin/questions (all questions, admin), POST /api/v1/questions/{id}/responses with {"response_answer":"<option text>"}. Folders named WRITES insert rows and change today's question: run them only against a disposable test database (make test-postman) unless you deliberately selected that environment. Read-only folders are safe on the working database. See docs/POSTMAN.md. Contains no tokens or keys.

item.name: Authentication (Microsoft Entra, manual)
item.description: Real sign-in through the Postman OAuth 2.0 helper: Authorization Code with PKCE, public client, no client secret. Open this request, Authorization tab, "Get New Access Token", sign in as the intended user, then copy the ACCESS token (not the ID token) into the matching token_* variable: three different non-admin accounts into the employee variables. Set expected_email_* to those accounts. Admin requests in this suite use X-Admin-Key (email mode); in Microsoft mode check admin access with the client collection and admin_token. See docs/POSTMAN.md.
